knowledge_points.title: Present Perfect Tense (现在完成时)
knowledge_points.content: 构成：have/has + 过去分词。用法：1.表示过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响或结果；2.表示过去开始的动作持续到现在。常与already, yet, just, ever, never, for+段时间, since+点时间连用。

knowledge_points.title: Reading Strategies
knowledge_points.content: Skimming(略读) for main idea; Scanning(查读) for specific information; Predicting(预测) before reading.

exam_points.name: 现在完成时与一般过去时的区别
exam_points.content: 现在完成时强调与现在的联系，一般过去时只表示过去发生的事。

test_questions.content: —______ you ______ your homework yet? —Yes, I ______ it an hour ago.
test_questions.explanation: 第一空yet常与现在完成时连用，第二空an hour ago是一般过去时，故选B。

knowledge_points.title: Modal Verbs (情态动词)
knowledge_points.content: can/could表示能力和请求；must表示必须和肯定推测；should表示建议和责备；may/might表示许可和可能。must的疑问句否定回答用needn't。

exam_points.name: 情态动词的用法
exam_points.content: 考查情态动词表推测、责备等用法。

test_questions.content: You ______ be tired after such a long journey. Let me help you with your luggage.
test_questions.explanation: must表示肯定的推测，意为“一定”，故选B。

knowledge_points.title: Non-restrictive Attributive Clauses (非限制性定语从句)
knowledge_points.content: 与主句之间用逗号隔开，对先行词作补充说明，去掉后不影响主句意思。引导词：which, who, whom, whose, as。注意：非限制性定语从句中不能用that。

knowledge_points.title: Health Vocabulary
knowledge_points.content: stay up late, skip meals, be on a diet, work out, side effects, suffer from, in the long term。

exam_points.name: 非限制性定语从句
exam_points.content: 考查which引导非限制性定语从句，指代整个主句。

test_questions.content: The road conditions there turned out to be very good, ______ was more than we could expect.
test_questions.explanation: which引导非限制性定语从句，指代前面整句话内容，that不能引导非限制性定语从句，故选C。
test_questions.source: 2023年华东师大二附中高一期末考试

knowledge_points.title: Present Perfect Continuous (现在完成进行时)
knowledge_points.content: 构成：have/has been doing。用法：表示从过去某时开始一直持续到现在的动作，强调动作的持续性。常与all day, for hours, since等连用。

exam_points.name: 现在完成进行时
exam_points.content: 考查现在完成进行时与现在完成时的区别。

test_questions.content: I ______ for three hours. I must be very tired.
test_questions.explanation: 强调从过去到现在一直在工作且可能继续，用现在完成进行时，故选B。
test_questions.source: 2023年上海交大附中高一期中考试

knowledge_points.title: Future Continuous (将来进行时)
knowledge_points.content: 构成：will be doing。用法：表示将来某一时刻正在进行的动作，或表示将来某段时间内持续进行的动作。

knowledge_points.title: Travel Vocabulary
knowledge_points.content: go on an adventure, explore, tourist attraction, accommodation, souvenir, breathtaking, in advance。

exam_points.name: 将来进行时
exam_points.content: 考查将来进行时的用法。

test_questions.content: This time tomorrow I ______ on the beach in Hawaii.
test_questions.explanation: This time tomorrow表示将来某一时刻正在进行，用将来进行时，故选B。

knowledge_points.title: Past Perfect Tense (过去完成时)
knowledge_points.content: 构成：had + 过去分词。用法：表示在过去某一时间或动作之前已经发生或完成的动作，即“过去的过去”。常与by the time, before, when等连用。

exam_points.name: 过去完成时
exam_points.content: 考查过去完成时与一般过去时的区别。

test_questions.content: By the time he arrived at the station, the train ______.
test_questions.explanation: 火车离开发生在他到达之前，是“过去的过去”，用过去完成时，故选C。
test_questions.source: 2023年华东师大二附中高一期末考试

chapters.name: Unit 1 The World of Our Senses

knowledge_points.title: Noun Clauses (名词性从句)
knowledge_points.content: 包括主语从句、宾语从句、表语从句、同位语从句。引导词：that, whether, if, who, what, which, when, where, why, how。注意：that在名词性从句中不充当成分，what充当主语、宾语或表语。

exam_points.name: 名词性从句
exam_points.content: 考查引导词的选择和语序。

test_questions.content: ______ made the school proud was ______ more than 90% of the students had been admitted to key universities.
test_questions.explanation: 第一空what引导主语从句并在从句中作主语；第二空that引导表语从句，不充当成分，故选B。
test_questions.source: 2023年上海交大附中高一期末考试

knowledge_points.title: Object Complement (宾语补足语)
knowledge_points.content: 宾语补足语用来补充说明宾语的动作或状态。常见结构：make sb do sth, let sb do sth, have sb do sth, find sb doing sth, consider sb to be, with +宾语+宾补。

knowledge_points.title: Language Vocabulary
knowledge_points.content: consist of, contribute to, depend on, make up, stand for, throughout history, native speaker。

exam_points.name: 宾语补足语
exam_points.content: 考查with复合结构和make/let等使役动词的宾补。

test_questions.content: With a lot of difficult problems ______, the newly-elected president is having a hard time.
test_questions.explanation: 问题尚未解决，用不定式表示将来，with+宾语+to do结构，故选C。

knowledge_points.title: Appositive Clauses (同位语从句)
knowledge_points.content: 同位语从句用来解释说明前面名词的具体内容，常放在fact, news, idea, hope, belief, doubt, possibility等名词后。引导词that不充当成分但不能省略。

exam_points.name: 同位语从句
exam_points.content: 考查同位语从句与定语从句的区别。

test_questions.content: The news ______ our team has won the match is exciting.
test_questions.explanation: that引导同位语从句，解释说明news的具体内容，that在从句中不充当成分，故选A。

knowledge_points.title: Passive Voice (被动语态)
knowledge_points.content: 构成：be + 过去分词。常用时态：一般现在时am/is/are done；一般过去时was/were done；现在完成时have/has been done；带情态动词must be done。

exam_points.name: 被动语态
exam_points.content: 考查各种时态的被动语态。

test_questions.content: The new library ______ next month will be the biggest one in our city.
test_questions.explanation: next month表将来，用不定式的被动式作后置定语，故选D。

knowledge_points.title: Subject-verb Agreement (主谓一致)
knowledge_points.content: 三大原则：语法一致、意义一致、就近原则。就近原则：either...or, neither...nor, not only...but also, there be句型中谓语与最近的主语一致。

knowledge_points.title: Sports Vocabulary
knowledge_points.content: compete in, take part in, in honor of, make contributions to, play a role in, be recognized as。

exam_points.name: 主谓一致
exam_points.content: 考查就近原则和集合名词的主谓一致。

test_questions.content: Either you or one of your students ______ to attend the meeting that is due tomorrow.
test_questions.explanation: either...or...遵循就近原则，one of your students是单数，谓语用is，故选B。

knowledge_points.title: Verbs + to do / doing
knowledge_points.content: 只接to do：want, hope, decide, refuse, manage, agree, promise。只接doing：enjoy, finish, mind, avoid, suggest, practice, consider。两者都可但意思不同：remember/forget to do（未做）/doing（已做）；stop to do（停下来去做）/doing（停止做）；mean to do（打算做）/doing（意味着）。

exam_points.name: 非谓语动词
exam_points.content: 考查to do和doing作宾语的区别。

test_questions.content: I remembered ______ the door before I left the office, but I forgot to turn off the lights.
test_questions.explanation: remember doing表示记得做过某事，lock这个动作已经完成，故选A。
test_questions.source: 2023年华东师大二附中高二期末考试

knowledge_points.title: V-ing as Subject/Object (动名词作主语/宾语)
knowledge_points.content: 动名词作主语：Learning English is important. 作宾语：I enjoy reading. 常用句型：It's no use doing sth, There is no point doing sth。

knowledge_points.title: Relationship Vocabulary
knowledge_points.content: get along with, be determined to do, keep one's word, apologize to sb for sth, be jealous of, in trouble。

exam_points.name: 动名词
exam_points.content: 考查动名词作主语和宾语的用法。

test_questions.content: It's no use ______ without taking any action.
test_questions.explanation: It's no use doing sth为固定句型，意为“做某事没用”，故选C。

knowledge_points.title: Inversion (倒装句)
knowledge_points.content: 完全倒装：副词/介词短语+谓语+主语。部分倒装：否定词(hardly, never, seldom, little等)置于句首时，助动词/情态动词/be动词提前。Only+状语置于句首也用部分倒装。

exam_points.name: 倒装句
exam_points.content: 考查部分倒装和完全倒装的应用。

test_questions.content: ______ had I arrived at the station when the train started to move.
test_questions.explanation: Hardly...when...为固定句型，意为“一...就...”，hardly置于句首用部分倒装，故选B。

knowledge_points.title: Subjunctive Mood (虚拟语气)
knowledge_points.content: if虚拟条件句：与现在事实相反，从句用过去式(be用were)，主句用would/could/might do；与过去事实相反，从句用had done，主句用would have done；与将来事实相反，从句用should do/were to do/过去式，主句用would do。

exam_points.name: 虚拟语气
exam_points.content: 考查if虚拟条件句的各种时态。

test_questions.content: If I ______ you, I would take the opportunity to go abroad.
test_questions.explanation: 与现在事实相反的虚拟语气，从句be动词统一用were，故选C。
